model.name: layout.compose
model.description: R31.5 UMBRELLA rollup UC: the responsive bar/compartment layout is COMPOSED by RbStrip - the composed-layout engine the R31.5.1-5.7 primitives roll up into (RbStrip.renderDescriptors composes the RbCompartments per descriptor; 5.5 editor [L]|[C]|[R] and 5.6 WODA W|[O][D]|A are its instances; 5.3 snap-nav; 5.7 drawer=Details compartment). Architect target 2026-07-26: REUSE Class RbStrip + Method RbStrip.renderDescriptors (NO new node) as the umbrella's chain hop, so R31.5 terminates on the real composed-layout engine rather than a bare umbrella. The 5.1-5.7 sub-requirements own their own chains; this UC binds the umbrella req to the composition method.
